tension_summary: The most operationally complete German automotive executive available externally — 34 years, floor-to-COO at VW, IG Metall landmark agreement, Dieselgate managed, ID.Buzz transition delivered — but he has never worked anywhere but Volkswagen, his compensation expectation is the highest in the pool, his notice period is the longest, and the question of whether a 34-year VW executive can genuinely transfer his authority and instincts into a BMW culture that considers itself fundamentally different is one that only the first 90 days in the role will actually answer.
